decisions.reason: Using subject-relevant images to fill empty space does not change the selected body typeface or weight treatment.
The whitespace remedy does not change author-name or author-photo presentation.
The source addresses conspicuous empty space on affected pages, not the separate treatment of articles containing too much uninterrupted text.
Adding images to fill article-page whitespace does not change the required two-page-spread behavior of the flipbook PDF.
The source does not change article order, flat-plan authority, or any specified page placement.
Auxiliary subject-matter images used for whitespace balance do not alter the required tribute page or required article list.
The source specifies image quantity and subject relevance but does not change the existing image-quality enhancement rule.
The source replaces the whitespace remedy with subject-relevant article images and does not change advertisement rendering quality.
The whitespace fix does not modify the table-of-contents completion condition or page-number accuracy requirement.
The same source message contains a separate Heyzine-branding decision already captured by a complete same-message MODIFY; the whitespace-balance change requires no additional event or edit.
The statement that one hour remains for fixes provides urgency but does not establish a new launch deadline or lifecycle change.
Requiring subject-relevant images for whitespace balance does not change the established overall visual style, branding reference, or red-color rule.
